class.name: IfcConstraintAggregationRelationship
class.brief_description: An IfcConstraintAggregationRelationship is an objectified relationship that enables instances of IfcConstraint subtypes to be aggregated together logically. HISTORY New Entity in IFC Release 2.0. Modified in IFC2x2. IFC2x4 CHANGE Subtyped from IfcConstraintRelationship Use definition IfcConstraintAggregationRelationship allows the aggregation link between subtypes of constraint to be logically def
